Let z = x + iy

| z + i | = | z 3i |

y = 1

Now

= x2 + y2 2x 2iy + 2

= x2 + 1 2x 2i + 2

Re() = x2 2x + 3

Re() = (x 1)2 + 2

Re()min at x = 1 z = 1 + i

Now,

= 1 + 1 2 2i + 2

= 2(1 i) = 2

n = 2

If n is real n = 4
